releaseNotes:
NextGenSoftware.OASIS.API.Providers.SuiOASIS v2.0.5

Connects the OASIS to Sui -- Move-language object-centric blockchain with parallel transaction execution and near-instant finality. Stores OASIS holons and avatars as Sui objects. Part of the OASIS HOT-Swappable Provider Architecture. Ecosystem: https://oasisomniverse.one
